name: Data Access Security Data Owner Election New Task
description: Sent to voters and reviewers who still have outstanding work in a running data owner election, on the election's configured reminder schedule or on demand by an administrator.
subject: Reminder: Data Owner Election tasks await your input
body:
Data Owner Election tasks await your input

Hi $__recipient.name,

You still have outstanding work in a Data Owner Election that requires your attention.

You currently have $election.taskCount Data Owner Election tasks awaiting your input.

Use the link below to view your pending data ownership election tasks in Data Access Security: View Pending Data Ownership Election Tasks.

Thank you for your attention. This is an automated message from Data Access Security; please do not reply.
